Jack plays table tennis with Leo every Thursday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus terminal by bike. The weather was cloudy that day. The children spent a carefree summer by the lake.
Leo is interested in singing. Jack likes cloudy days best. The bus terminal is one of the best places in the city. What's more, the bridge was rebuilt in local timber.
Both of them like fish and juice. Jack usually has fish for breakfast. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, the study links diet to socioeconomic background.
Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Jack thinks English is interesting but a little difficult.
